verdicts.heartSection: FIX: (1) Great-vessel connections are wrong. The aortic root (x520-610,y350) sits over the RV/septum, not over the LV (cavity x690-800,y545-760); the flowLeft arrow runs (712,720)->(585,410) diagonally through solid pink myocardium. Rebuild so the LV outflow runs up from the LV top-medial (~x660-700,y545) as a visible aortic root with a 3-cusp valve (cream, ~y520-560) and the ascending aorta rises into the arch at x~580-690; arch descending limb should not end cut-off at (815,295) behind the LPA - continue it behind the trunk or end it with a clean cut-ellipse. (2) Pulmonary trunk (x575-725,y250-410) ends in the middle of the atrial myocardium, not at the RV. Move the RV outflow tract/infundibulum up so the RV cavity (currently top ~y575) extends to a pulmonary valve at the trunk base (~x610,y400), trunk anterior to the aorta (already in front, keep), and add a 3-cusp pulmonary valve. flowRight must continue RV -> trunk -> LPA and RPA; it currently stops in the RV at (575,690). (3) Chambers do not connect: RA (x390-500,y395-550), tricuspid leaflets (x428-500,y558-590) and RV (x455-640,y572-740) are separate blobs with pink tissue between. Extend the RA floor and RV roof so the tricuspid orifice is one open passage with leaflets spanning it; same for LA->mitral->LV (LA bottom is a flat slab at y500-545 with leaflets floating over the LV top at y545). Chambers should read as one continuous maroon lumen per side with a clear thin septum, not islands in a pink slab. (4) Proportions: the pink interior mass between chambers (x500-690,y420-570 and the septum x640-690) is huge and unlabelled-looking; the septum should be a thin wall (~25-35px) between RV and LV. The LV cavity (~100px wide) is narrower than the RV (~185px); make the LV the largest, elongated cavity forming the apex with the thick wall (keep ~60px free wall), RV crescent wrapped on its right. (5) IVC (x400-465,y685-840) does not reach the RA: it stops under the RV. Run it up behind the heart's lower-left border into the RA floor (~x430,y550) and open the RA to meet it; likewise open the RA top to the SVC (end y345 vs RA top y395). The left-side pulmonary vein at (285-360,y405-440) lies over the RA; pulmonary veins must enter the LA - move it to the LA side (two veins each side entering LA at x650-830) or delete it. (6) Anchor pv (872,442) sits in the gap between the two vein tubes; move to (880,408) or (880,475). av (568,560) sits in pink tissue away from the AV junction; move to the RA floor/septum junction ~(500,565), and shift the His start (583,568) and branches accordingly so the bundle runs down the septum top at x~650, not through the middle of the pink mass. sa (457,392) is on the epicardial edge; place at the SVC/RA junction ~(440,375). Labels of flowRight/compress/rosc/vf/stop/tricuspid overlap at y598-627 in the anchors tile; spread them (e.g. flowRight (420,420), vf/stop on LV (745,640), compress mid-chest (600,700), rosc (780,700)). (7) Events: conduction path is the right sequence (SA->AV->His->two branches) but lies on top of the tissue with no atrial pathway; end the LBB inside the septum surface and add the Purkinje fringe to the apex; fine otherwise after the anatomy is fixed. ra/rv/la/lv highlights are a muddy orange-brown fill; use a lighter tint or brighter outline so the chamber still reads maroon. stop-45 vs vf-45 are nearly identical (both dim with open leaflets): give vf a visible irregular quiver of the ventricle outline/walls (amplitude >=6px) and keep stop frozen; compress-45 vs base-45 differ by a few px only - add a clear systolic squeeze (cavities visibly smaller, leaflets closed) vs relaxed. (8) Idiom: vessels and hatching are good, but valve leaflets are tiny white slivers and papillary muscles are pale pink triangles that look like leaflets; draw papillary muscles as maroon-brown mounds on the ventricular wall (darker than the cavity) with chordae in cream, leaflets larger cream cusps. Hatching exists on the cut myocardium but is faint; strengthen to ink-plate contour hatching and keep the background white.
